methodology: Deterministic and scenario-based regression; no trained model and no statistical k-fold claim. Test CSVs are generated from actual JUnit results. Quality CSVs contain separately measured metrics. Historical CSVs apply only to the recorded source hashes and dates; newly catalogued modules have no implied historical measurement.
